description_en: Renews the bandwidth of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance. This operation is deprecated because the bandwidth billing method has been upgraded to the pay-as-you-go pattern
description_zh: 云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的带宽已升级为按量付费模式，不再推荐使用本接口
name: RenewAdditionalBandwidth

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: enables automatic payment. This is the default value.
false: disables automatic payment. You must manually pay for the order. To do so, choose Billing > Renewal Management in the top navigation bar of the console, and then choose Order Management > My Orders in the left-side navigation pane to find and pay for the order
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费。取值：

true：自动付费，默认值。
false：手动付费。您需要在控制台的顶部菜单栏，单击费用 > 续费管理，然后单击左侧导航栏的订单管理 > 我的订单，找到目标订单进行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The purchase duration. Unit: days. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365, 730, 1095, and 1825
parameters.name: order_time_length

parameters.help_en: The call source. This parameter is used only for internal maintenance. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 调用来源，本参数仅用于内部维护使用，无需传入
parameters.name: source_biz
